event_id.description: Unique identifier for the discrete event log.

timestamp.description: Logical clock tick when event occurred.

manager.description: The specific OS manager sub-system producing the event.

event_type.description: The type of event (e.g., CPU_PREEMPT, PAGE_FAULT, ACCESS_DENIED).

entity_id.description: Unique ID of the entity affected in the Shared Data Model (e.g., PID, Path, Frame ID).

action.description: Action performed (e.g., ALLOCATE, FREED, READ, WRITE, INTERRUPT).

outcome.description: Outcome status of the requested action.

details.description: Extra details and metrics tailored to the specific type of event.
